book_title: 不等式的秘密 第2卷
title: 练习7
stem_md: (Pham Kim Hung, Mathlinks) 设 $x, y, z$ 是正实数, 且满足 $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3$ 证明 $\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{x + y}} - 1\right)\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{y + z}} - 1\right)\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{z + x}} - 1\right) \geqslant (\sqrt{2} - 1)^3$
original_text_md: 7. (Pham Kim Hung, Mathlinks) 设 $x, y, z$ 是正实数, 且满足 $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 3$ 证明 $\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{x + y}} - 1\right)\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{y + z}} - 1\right)\left(\frac{2}{\sqrt{z + x}} - 1\right) \geqslant (\sqrt{2} - 1)^3$
